title: Turkish Shrimp Ceviche
description: A refreshing Turkish-inspired ceviche dish made with succulent shrimp, zesty lime juice, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, zesty, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the shrimp to 'cook' in the lime juice.
Just before serving, stir in the sliced red onion and chopped cilantro.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Note: If you prefer a cooked ceviche, you can sauté the shrimp in a little oil until pink and then let it cool before serving.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 hours before serving.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
